propositions: External integration tests run only against Anthropic provider despite rebar supporting multiple providers (Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenAI), leaving Bedrock and OpenAI regressions undetected in CI.
Provider selection must become an explicit matrix dimension in CI workflows rather than an ambient default, with each arm obtaining credentials and provider config via documented override mechanisms.
Bedrock arm must authenticate via OIDC role assumption to a dedicated scoped role on GitHub-hosted runners, as the S7 EC2 instance-role path is unreachable from ubuntu-latest.
Each provider arm must skip loudly with visible output when its credential is absent, making missing secrets distinguishable from successful runs in CI output.
Config file overlays must set only [llm.model_classes] per arm, not bare REBAR_LLM_MODEL, and must be verified to change provider/model while leaving other discovered config intact.

Bedrock arm must explicitly resolve AWS region by setting both REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION and AWS_DEFAULT_REGION as job environment, failing loudly rather than silently degrading when region is unresolved.
